lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: عَسْعَسَ is in the derivative form: عَسْعَسَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/س/ع/س   ʿ–s–ʿ–s (quadrilatiral root derived from root ع/س/س ʿ–s–s) wolf, hunting dog; to roam by night; to hunt by night; to seek, to go after, to stalk; (of day light) to appear, (of night darkness) to descend. Of this root, onlyعَسْعَسَ ʿasʿasa, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
عَسْعَسَ ʿasʿasa [v. quadrilateral. intrans.] to clear away, to pull away; to descend, to infiltrate, to seep in

(81:17) وَاللَّيْلِ‏ ‏إِذَا‏ ‏عَسْعَسَ by the night when it gradually descends (or, when it gradually lifts). ‏
